lesson.title: Reading the word banana
lesson.goal: Say, stress, spell and understand the word banana.

say: Here is a new word: banana. Listen as I say it, ba, na, na.
One part is louder than the others. It is the middle one, ba, NA, na.
Now we spell it, one letter at a time. B, A, N, A, N, A.
Is a banana a red fruit? No. It is a long yellow fruit, and that is the right card.
